visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with short dark hair tied in two small buns walks across a sandy backyard. She wears a beige sweatshirt featuring a colorful graphic of food on the back and loose blue jeans. A large black plastic basket sits on the ground near a pile of fallen starfruits. The background shows trees and sunlight casting long shadows. (2) The girl turns to face the camera, looking directly at the filmer with a bright, curious expression. She gestures with her small hands as she speaks animatedly. Sunlight illuminates her face, highlighting her youthful features. Behind her, lush green foliage and stone-lined garden beds are visible under the bright daylight. (3) She leans down and begins to pick up yellow and green starfruits from the pile. She places them carefully into the black basket. Her colorful Crocs-style shoes stand out against the grey-brown sand. A rake leans against a tree trunk in the background, suggesting recent yard work. (4) A large, short-haired brown dog enters the frame from the right, walking slowly behind the girl. She notices the dog, points a finger at it, and calls out, her mouth open in a wide smile. The dog continues its path toward the background where a white house is visible. (5) The girl picks up a specific starfruit and holds it close to her face, squinting her eyes as she examines its surface for defects or insects. She shows it to the camera before deciding to discard it. The lighting remains bright and natural, creating high contrast between the sunny patches and deep shadows. (6) Standing near the starfruit tree, the girl points upward with her right hand toward the branches laden with fruit. She looks up with an expectant expression, searching for ripe produce. A white car and a set of stairs leading to a building are partially visible in the distant background. (7) A woman's legs and hands enter the frame, holding a very large, ripe yellow starfruit. The girl reaches out with both hands to take it, her eyes widening in surprise at its size. She grips the fruit firmly, looking back at the woman who is wearing white shorts and red sandals. (8) The girl sits down on the edge of a wooden porch or bench. She holds the large starfruit with both hands and takes a large, enthusiastic bite. Her cheeks are full as she chews, looking contentedly toward the camera. The scene ends with a close-up of her smiling face as she enjoys her harvest.
